name: Hutzper Inc.
summary: Hutzper, Inc. provides information technology services, including MEKIKI, a visual inspection AI for the manufacturing industry, Custom Hutzper AI, an AI development service, and Skill Puzzle, an AI solution for optimized workforce allocation. Hiro Inishi, Kota Kurose and Kazuki Yumiba founded it in 2020, and it has its headquarters in Osaka, Japan.
